first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: A child riding Vehicle A with their back to the camera, with neck-length short brown hair, wearing a red long-sleeved top and dark blue overalls.

entities.name: Vehicle A
entities.identification: The low tricycle carrying Person A, with a tall blue backrest, a partially exposed low red frame, and two wide black rear wheels.

entities.name: orange-brown geometric-patterned carpet
entities.identification: The carpet laid continuously through the passageway, with thick orange zigzags, a dark brown background, and red center blocks.

entities.name: interior wall
entities.identification: The large light-beige wall surfaces in the passageway, with dark brown baseboards along the bottom and vertical boundaries formed by wall corners and door edges.

entities.name: interior door
entities.identification: The set of brown interior doors visible in this clip, including the partial door panel at the image-left edge in the initial frame and the doors on both sides and at the end of the corridor in the later portion.

entities.name: ceiling
entities.identification: The light-colored ceiling extending into the depth above the corridor, with light-colored molding visible along its edges.

entities.name: interior ceiling light
entities.identification: The fixtures with white circular shades arranged along the corridor ceiling, with bright lower surfaces.

entities.name: potted plant at the end of the corridor
entities.identification: The potted plant to the image-left of the door at the end of the corridor; the green plant and terracotta-colored pot are visible in earlier images, while only part of the pot is exposed in the final frame.

entities.name: red wall plate at the end of the corridor
entities.identification: A discernible red circular wall-mounted object above and to the image-left of the door at the end of the corridor.
